machine_contract.principle: domain semantics compile inside bounded windows; machine services receive normalized propagation requests

bound_operations.CASEPATH_DISPATCH: existing CasePath managed dispatch through KEX/WBOS

identity_rule: BRAINK, KEX, CasePath, ClaimPath, workbook, site, carrier, projection and host remain distinct identities. They converge only on the canonical propagation ABI.
state_rule: visible state does not become authoritative until a COMMITTED RECEIPT is returned
proof_rule: hash chaining establishes consistency and lineage; it is not described as externally immutable without an independent witness

deployment_boundary.reason: repository/runtime integration is implemented and CI-qualified where GitHub executes it; physical owner-host activation still requires direct host service-manager authority
